environment.description: Celery worker running on ECS Fargate task in private subnet. The upload API (Flask) receives multipart XML uploads at /api/v2/invoices/upload, enqueues the raw XML body into Redis, and the Celery worker picks it up. The API is fronted by an ALB with no WAF association. The Fargate task has outbound internet access via NAT gateway for vendor API callbacks. No XML-specific input filtering is applied at any layer.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, task role with DynamoDB write, outbound NAT
config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, no egress filtering
config.load_balancer: ALB with default listener, no WAF WebACL attached
